notes: The catalog text holds no section for the CSU General Education Breadth Certificate of Achievement. It shows only graduation rules, the General Education Philosophy and 'Plan A: General Education Requirements (AA/AS)', which is Grossmont's local GE pattern for the associate degree. It is cut off mid Area 5 ('CHEM-110 Environmental Chemi').

The certificate's own section, likely CSU GE Breadth or its Cal-GETC successor, probably follows later on the page beyond the cut. Plan A areas were therefore not recorded as this award's blocks, because they include courses outside the CSU GE pattern (e.g., CSIS-240, ART-124, ENGL-126, THTR-130).
A reviewer should fetch the full page and record the certificate section if it exists.
The 'Recipients of an Associate Degree will be equipped to' list belongs to the associate degree GE philosophy, not this certificate, so it was not recorded as outcomes.
No total units, outcomes or careers for the certificate are printed in the supplied text.
section_heading names the page-level 'General Education' heading only because no heading for this award appears in the text.

Part 2: The catalog text contains no section for the CSU General Education Breadth Certificate of Achievement. It prints only the Grossmont College Plan A local General Education requirements for the AA/AS (Areas 1-5), which is a different pattern for the associate degree. So no blocks are recorded for this award.

Part 2: The text is cut off mid-entry in Area 5 at 'CHEM-110 Environmental Chemi'. The CSU GE Breadth certificate section may follow later on the page. A reviewer should fetch the full page, or the certificate's own page.
Part 2: The 'General Education Philosophy' list ('think critically', etc.) describes recipients of an Associate Degree, not this certificate, so it is not recorded as program outcomes.
Part 2: CSU GE Breadth was superseded by Cal-GETC as of Fall 2025. The 2026-2027 catalog may no longer print this certificate; check whether the award is still offered.
